subject.title: fix(memory-wiki): reject oversized apply body files

question: Should `openclaw wiki apply synthesis --body-file` adopt a new hard 1 MiB public input limit for existing users?
rationale: The implementation intentionally changes formerly accepted CLI input into an error, and the repository evidence supplied here does not establish an existing documented limit or an approved upgrade policy.

options.title: Preserve current acceptance
options.body: Do not land the hard cap until resource protection can be delivered without newly rejecting existing valid body files or through an explicitly compatible interface.

options.title: Approve the 1 MiB contract
options.body: Adopt the cap as a deliberate public CLI policy and require clear upgrade rationale, final-head real CLI evidence, and maintainer acceptance of affected existing workflows.

recommendation.title: Preserve current acceptance
recommendation.body: Do not land the hard cap until resource protection can be delivered without newly rejecting existing valid body files or through an explicitly compatible interface.
